description: This file defines a Perl module 'processhelp' providing process management utilities such as sleeping, process existence checks, termination, signals, and socket filter process management for the cURL project.

methods.name: portable_sleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of seconds using the most appropriate method depending on system capabilities and platform.

methods.name: pidfromfile
methods.description: Reads and returns the process ID stored in a specified PID file, or 0 on error or if invalid.

methods.name: pidexists
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID exists and is alive, returning the PID or 0.

methods.name: pidterm
methods.description: Requests a process with a specific PID to terminate gracefully.

methods.name: pidkill
methods.description: Forcefully kills a process with a given PID.

methods.name: pidwait
methods.description: Waits for a process with a given PID to terminate.

methods.name: processexists
methods.description: Checks if the process indicated in a PID file exists and is alive; removes the PID file if process is dead.

methods.name: killpid
methods.description: Attempts to gracefully stop processes in a list, then force kills remaining ones.

methods.name: killsockfilters
methods.description: Kills sockfilter processes for a specific server configuration.

methods.name: killallsockfilters
methods.description: Kills sockfilter processes for all server configurations.

methods.name: set_advisor_read_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock file to signal a read lock.
